## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass locally
- [ ] UI text is in Spanish and goes in `src/shared/copy/es.ts`; code, comments and tests are in English
- [ ] XP, credits and QR checks stay on the server (no client-trusted values)
- [ ] I tested against the emulators or the dev project, **not** the real event project
- [ ] `docs/progress.md` (and `docs/architecture.md` if a decision changed) are updated
- [ ] No secrets, `.env*` files or service account keys are in the diff
